summary: A classic anyone can play: the casual player found 8, and Kinshasa and Lima are fair stretches. Not a daily yet: 'delhi' costs a life at #148 because only the small New Delhi district counts, and Dhaka still uses a 2011 figure.
reasons: Casual found 8 (Tokyo, Beijing, Moscow, London, Mexico City, Cairo, Seoul, Jakarta) but was out of lives by guess 13; the fan got 10/10 for one life. Blitz is deep: 25 of 26 capitals named scored.

'new delhi' and 'delhi', among the first guesses most players make, cost a life as 'New Delhi is #148, 249,998': the table counts only the New Delhi district, while Beijing, Tokyo, Moscow and Kinshasa count as whole municipalities or provinces.
Dhaka sits at #11 on a 2011 figure (its 2022 census would rank #6), and non-capitals such as Istanbul cost a life with 'Istanbul isn't in the top 10', which never says it isn't a capital.
fixes: Dhaka: the source table still uses the 2011 census (8,906,039). Dhaka's own article gives 10,278,882 (2022 census), which ranks #6 and moves London (9,002,488) to #11. Needs a per-row value override with its source; the pipeline has none today. The casual replay still finds 7 with this change.

New Delhi: the table counts only the New Delhi Municipal Council area (249,998, 2011), so 'delhi' and 'new delhi' cost a life at #148. Count the National Capital Territory of Delhi (16,787,941 in the 2011 census, per Delhi's article), as the table does for Beijing, Tokyo, Moscow and Kinshasa: it ranks #2, Mexico City (#11) and London (#12) become the near misses, and the casual replay still finds 7. The shown value would then differ from the linked Wikipedia table.

Non-capital cities from `also: CITIES` (Istanbul, Lagos, Karachi, Mumbai, Sydney) cost a life with 'Istanbul isn't in the top 10', which reads as if Istanbul were a capital. Drop `also: CITIES` from this topic so they are free, or (UI) have that miss say it isn't a national capital.
